title: Last 24 hours: Exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and reach 10,000+ tech leaders
originalTitle: Last 24 hours: Exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and reach 10,000+ tech leaders
content:
Exhibit bookings for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 close in less than 24 hours. From October 13-15, 10,000+ founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders will arrive at San Francisco’s Moscone West looking for companies, products, ideas, and people worth knowing. The question is: Will they find your startup?

You have until 11:59 p.m. PT tonight, October 2 — or until the remaining tables sell out — to secure your place in the Expo Hall, the heart of Disrupt. Find out more and book your spot before your competitor takes your table.

Don’t just attend — give startup leaders something to discover

Disrupt brings thousands of people together, but an exhibit table gives your startup a home base for three days. A place to demo what you’ve built. Start conversations with investors, clients, and potential partners. And turn a quick introduction in the Expo Hall into something that continues after Disrupt.

Use your exhibit presence to:

  • Show, rather than tell. Put your product directly in front of the people who could fund, use, or partner with you.
  • Start more conversations. Meet anyone in tech already exploring the Expo Hall specifically to discover new breakthroughs.
  • Get closer to investors. Founders receive access to additional opportunities, including investor-to-founder networking and a quieter area in the Deal Flow Café.
  • Generate leads. Capture high-quality leads through the Disrupt mobile app and build a pipeline to follow up after the event.
  • Bring your team. Cover more of Disrupt with five all-access Exhibitor–Partner passes and five Expo+ passes included in the package.

Three days. Thousands of potential introductions.

The Expo Hall is where products become conversations. One demo could introduce you to your next customer. One question could lead to an investor meeting. One conversation could uncover a partnership you hadn’t considered before arriving in San Francisco. And with 10,000+ decision-makers expected at Disrupt, you have three days to create as many of those moments as possible.

Your exhibit table package includes space in the hall for all three days, 10 team passes, lead-generation tools through the event app, access to the TechCrunch Disrupt press list, website and app branding, partner Wi-Fi, and Silver Tier branding recognition. You’ve built something you want people to discover. Don’t leave it to chance.

Exhibit bookings close today, October 2, at 11:59 p.m. PT, or when the remaining tables sell out. Secure your table and put your startup at the center of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

Don’t plan to exhibit? Don’t miss Disrupt

You can still get in the room at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on October 13-15. Hear from 250+ top-tier tech leaders across 200+ sessions on six industry stages, roundtables, and breakouts that give you practical insights for building, funding, and scaling. Use AI-powered matchmaking and interactive sessions to make more relevant connections. Explore 300+ startups and witness Startup Battlefield 200, the ultimate pitch competition, to discover potential products, partners, and investment opportunities. Get your Disrupt ticket and be part of the conversations shaping what comes next. Bring your co-founder, partner, or peer at 50% off. Bring four or more for additional discounts.
